summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K to furnish its unaudited financial results for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2026, including a results presentation and press release. This is a routine earnings report with no mention of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. No deal terms or extraordinary corporate actions are disclosed.
